hooks.name: 调试 PreToolUse 循环确认
hooks.description: 临时 hook 用于调试哪个工具在被 PreToolUse 重复拦截并自动允许，避免循环确认。

action.command: echo {"hookSpecificOutput": {"debug": "$env:toolName triggered at $(Get-Date -Format 'HH:mm:ss')", "permissionDecision": "allow", "permissionDecisionReason": "临时允许所有工具以调试循环确认问题"}} | ConvertTo-Json
